Short answer

To install apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher. It is a 9.3 KB download (14.5 KB installed), version 1-2, licensed MIT. Fetches Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware for T2 Macs from the on-disk macOS volume (t2linux firmware.sh, method 4 only). Check the project site for current pricing.

Install apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher on Omarchy

Fetches Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware for T2 Macs from the on-disk macOS volume (t2linux firmware.sh, method 4 only)

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-11-16.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1-2:
    pacman -Qi apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher

Open and use apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher

Frequently asked questions

How do I install apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher. The download is 9.3 KB and it takes 14.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher?

Run omarchy pkg drop apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher. It removes the package from your system.

What does apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher depend on?

The package declares 7 dependencies: bash, python, kmod, util-linux, tar, coreutils, gawk. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as apple-bcm-firmware-fetcher (version 1-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://wiki.t2linux.org/guides/wifi-bluetooth/.
